verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a REST API (incorporation, notarization, translation, tax and trade registration endpoints), webhooks and an llms.txt, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. Raw HTTP endpoints are a building block, not an SDK, and no OpenAPI spec was found from which clients could be generated. An API-first SaaS could plausibly ship SDKs, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.
